# Frequently Asked Workshop Questions

Source: [5338](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/5338); edited 2025-03-19. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-5338-n1"></a>

- Disallow Button blocks native ability activation while Is Button Held can still trigger replacement behavior; Ability Cooldown can gate and display the replacement cooldown.

<a id="wiki-5338-n2"></a>

- A waiting action list with Ignore Condition keeps its rule instance occupied through a custom cooldown loop.

<a id="wiki-5338-n3"></a>

- One global HUD using Local Player can display each viewer's player variable without a separate HUD per joining player.

<a id="wiki-5338-n4"></a>

- Detect hero swaps by comparing stored currentHero with Hero Of, then update the stored hero; reset modified stats to defaults before applying hero-specific values.

<a id="wiki-5338-n5"></a>

- Capture the dummy-bot reference via Last Created Entity immediately after creation before issuing controls.

<a id="wiki-5338-n6"></a>

- Player Closest To Reticle includes dead players; filter living candidates and sort by facing-to-target angle, optionally applying radius/LOS first.

Source limitations:

- FAQ radius example switches from opposite team in first example to Team Of(Event Player) in second; should not blindly label it enemy targeting.

- Examples contain abbreviated or named-argument Workshop syntax; verify supported import representation.

- Dummy creation on each spawned player lacks an explicit dummy exclusion; assess recursion/slot exhaustion before reusing whole example.
